Why this correction is needed

The genuine V6 diagnostic received the configured Supabase HTTPS URL and an opaque server key. The earlier factory accepts only JWT-shaped server keys, so it returns 503 before processing the test schedule. V7 accepts the existing injected legacy JWT or strictly formatted opaque secret key. Opaque keys use the apikey header; legacy keys retain both existing headers. Signed-in users still use their own JWT.

The route allowlist, custom caller authentication, HMAC checks, Vault references, company scope, destinations, permissions, timeouts and original caps remain the same. No environment value, key or account is changed.
